original_benchmark.notes: Public eval-data-v1.2 bundle provides 217 ProteinGym v1.3 substitution assays (N=50 across seeds 1..3; default adapter split uses seed=1 -> 217 tasks). The 59 temporally held-out assays in the preprint are access-controlled and excluded.

harbor_adapter.notes: WIP adapter: 217 n50_b1 tasks verified at exact strict-permutation Spearman theoretical max (188/217 = 1.0 with distinct DMS_score; 29/217 have ground-truth ties capping strict-permutation max rho down to 0.7246 on ccdb-ecoli-tripathi-2016-n50-b1; Harbor flat Oracle mean = 0.99797, upstream UniProt-nested macro Oracle mean = 0.99857); task generation defaults to network_mode='public' for local Docker portability (including macOS Docker Desktop) and supports '--network-mode no-network' for Daytona / Linux cleanroom runs; default network_mode, registry publication, and parity plan pending maintainer confirmation.
